items.learningObjective: Coordinate multi-step changes across owners: sequence required checks and effects, compensate reversible work on failure, and preserve the stated invariant.
items.decisiveFact: The hold expires if payment is declined; an expired or declined attempt must leave the slot available and must not charge the driver. What should coordinate these steps?
items.nearestAlternative: Charge first, then try to reserve a charger; refund only if no slot remains. — Charging before securing capacity can debit a driver without a charger; retaining the hold after a decline violates the stated availability outcome.
items.changedCondition: For another resource-backed booking, identify temporary holds and release them when a required later step fails.
items.identityReason: The old and proposed item both test coordinating a multi-step workflow to preserve its stated invariant across boundaries. The updated case specifies the required ordering and failure outcome without changing that orchestration/compensation decision.
